summary: Iteration 3 backend testing complete. Photographer Style Profiles (auth, cross-user scoping, failure path, happy-path vision analysis) + full regression (iter1 + iter2) all pass. 22/22 tests green. One real LLM analysis was executed (Wikipedia Wedding_photography gallery -> status 'ready' with color_profile, edit_profile, description, confidence, images_analyzed>0, representative_image populated). Failure path (example.com) ended with status 'failed' and non-empty error_message — server did not crash. Cross-user scoping: user B cannot see, GET (404), or DELETE (404) user A's profile. Auth required on all 4 endpoints (GET list, POST, GET one, DELETE). Regression: cloud-job happy path still reaches 'completed' and produces a valid ZIP; projects CRUD, style-profiles, XMP generation, auth all still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines; still manageable but nearing the point where splitting routes into modules (auth, projects, styles, cloud_jobs, photographer_styles) would improve maintainability.

_bg_tasks fire-and-forget pattern is fine for now but has no persistence — if the process restarts mid-analysis, profiles will remain stuck in 'analyzing'. Consider a periodic reaper or storing task state so a restart can either resume or mark orphaned profiles as failed.

scrape_gallery_images uses only plain tags; galleries relying on lazy-loading (data-src) or CSS backgrounds will silently yield 0 images. Consider expanding selectors or documenting the limitation in the UI.
analyze_photographer_style should ideally cap total downloaded bytes to protect the container's memory from a hostile gallery URL — currently limit is by count (12) but not by size.
test_credentials: Emergent Google session-based; seeded fresh user+session pairs in test_database (users A, B, photoA, photoB) per iteration; cleaned up in fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral users/sessions and one directly-inserted photographer_styles doc for scoping test — all cleaned up in fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 photographer-styles endpoint is stable and vision analysis works with the Wikipedia gallery (~22s end-to-end). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3_photographer_styles.py. If re-running the happy-path test consumes LLM credits; prefer running only auth/scoping/failure tests with `-k 'not wikipedia'` for cheap regressions. KR Auto Nivelado is client-side only — not backend-testable.
